messages.text: There’s a new comment on PR #90
I’ll read the new comment on PR #90 and follow it through in the current prototype branch.

The new request is for x–y cross-sections of the three endcap wheels. I’ll add one panel per wheel with common axes, blue chambers and grey coil/frame sections, using the current geometry.

I’m using the repository’s coordination and review-validation skills to record and check the figures.

The Spack preflight still flags changed setup and lock-file fingerprints. I’ll verify the plotting environment before using it; these figures only read the saved geometry and need no ACTS rebuild or propagation run.

The three sections are generated at z = 6.7456, 9.5 and 12.8 m, on a common scale. They show 12, 108 and 24 chamber outlines respectively. The outer-wheel plane has no coil or frame intersection, which is reflected in the drawing.

The figures are pushed to PR #90 as a combined view and individual PNG/SVG files. The saved geometry, field map, OBJ files and propagation results are unchanged. The final visual review is checking labels, colours and source-coordinate agreement before I post the reply.

The views are added and I’ve replied on PR #90 with the image and download links. The independent final review found the sections correct and legible. I’m publishing its check record now; GitHub’s build check is still running.
